_comment: Brikko Studio plugin loader config — read by core at boot.
Each entry registers a plugin module that exposes the OpenClaw hook surface
Resolution: `module` is a Node import path. The core will `import(module)`
and call `createPlugin(config)`; the returned object's `hooks` are merged
into the pipeline in the order listed here.
Adding a plugin: append an entry. Disabling: set `enabled: false` rather
than removing — keeps the docker compose image self-contained for rollback.
Hot-reload of this file is NOT supported in M2 (see docs/M2_FOLLOWUPS.md).

mcp_servers.name: bitrix24
mcp_servers._comment: Spawned per-request. Trust=untrusted means pre_tool_call deanonymizes args by default; trusted servers (none in M2) bypass deanonymization.
